love.update წამში ბევრჯერ სრულდება. dt წ: love.update runs many times a second. dt is the time since the last frame — moving by speed * dt is equally fast on every computer. isDown checks whether an arrow key is pressed.
love.update-ის ბოლოს ვამოწმებთ, ეხება თუ: At the end of love.update we check whether the square touches the coin: two rectangles overlap if all four conditions hold. Then the score goes up and the coin appears in a new place.
love.draw ყოველ კადრზე ხატავს. setColor: love.draw draws every frame. setColor sets the color (red, green, blue — from 0 to 1), and rectangle draws a rectangle. The built-in LÖVE font has no non-Latin letters, so we write the score in English.
local player = { x = 100, y = 100, size:
local player = { x = 100, y = 100, size = 40, speed = 200 }
local coin = { x = 300, y = 200, size = 20 }
local score = 0

local function newCoin()
    coin.x = math.random(0, love.graphics.getWidth() - coin.size)
    coin.y = math.random(0, love.graphics.getHeight() - coin.size)
end

function love.load()
    love.window.setTitle("Collect the coins!")
    math.randomseed(os.time())
    newCoin()
end

function love.update(dt)
    if love.keyboard.isDown("right") then player.x = player.x + player.speed * dt end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("left") then player.x = player.x - player.speed * dt end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("down") then player.y = player.y + player.speed * dt end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("up") then player.y = player.y - player.speed * dt end

    if player.x < coin.x + coin.size and coin.x < player.x + player.size and
       player.y < coin.y + coin.size and coin.y < player.y + player.size then
        score = score + 1
        newCoin()
    end
end

function love.draw()
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 0.8, 0)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", coin.x, coin.y, coin.size, coin.size)
    love.graphics.setColor(0.2, 0.5, 1)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size)
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
    love.graphics.print("Score: " .. score, 10, 10)
end

padding შიდა დაშორებაა, border-radius კუ: padding is the inner space, border-radius rounds the corners, and box-shadow draws a soft shadow: 0 to the right, 10px down, a 30px spread and a half-transparent color.
თანაბარი სიგანე და სიმაღლე + border-radi: Equal width and height + border-radius: 50% = a circle. display: grid and place-items: center put the emoji in the middle of the circle. margin: 0 auto centers the avatar horizontally.
:hover სტილი მაშინ ჩაირთვება, როცა თაგვს: A :hover style turns on when you move the mouse over it. transition makes the change smooth, and transform: translateY(-4px) “lifts” the card up a little.

შექმენი ფაილი stopwatch.html, ჩასვი კოდი: Create a file stopwatch.html, paste the code and open it in the browser. React and Babel load from the internet, so you need to be online.

აჩვენე მეათედი წამებიც (setInterval 100: Show tenths of a second too (setInterval with 100 milliseconds)
React-ს და Babel-ს ინტერნეტიდან ვტვირთავ: We load React and Babel from the internet. Babel translates JSX (HTML-like code inside JavaScript) into something the browser understands — that is why our script’s type is text/babel. The app shows up in the <div id=\"root\">.
კომპონენტი ფუნქციაა, რომელიც JSX-ს აბრუნ: A component is a function that returns JSX. useState creates a state: seconds are the seconds, setSeconds is the function that changes it. When the state changes, React updates the screen by itself.
useEffect runs code after drawing. When running turns on, setInterval increases seconds by 1 every second. The returned function (clearInterval) stops the timer when running turns off.
წამებს წუთებად და წამებად ვყოფთ. padStar: We split the seconds into minutes and seconds. padStart(2, '0') adds a zero in front of a one-digit number: 7 → 07.
return-ში JSX-ია. { } ფრჩხილებში JavaScr: Inside return is JSX. JavaScript goes inside { } braces. onClick runs when the button is clicked. The last line draws the component into root.
